rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The minutes of the extraordinary cabinet meeting of 4 October 2021 (09:04-09:20), attended by 菅義偉 内閣総理大臣, record the decision of the resignation en masse (「内閣総辞職」について), to be notified that day to both Houses under Diet Act art. 64, and of the statement 本日，菅内閣は総辞職いたします.

locator.section: 開催日時; 出席者; 議事内容

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same minutes record the Chief Cabinet Secretary saying that, the Suga cabinet's resignation (菅内閣の総辞職) having just been decided, if an emergency such as an earthquake occurred the present cabinet must respond until the attestation ceremony ended and the new cabinet was launched (認証式が終了し，新内閣が発足するまでの間は，現内閣で対応する必要があります), and asking the ministers concerned to remain ready.

locator.section: 議事内容 (緊急時の対応)
